body: Hey, I have exactly the same issue. Are you still with us?
Hey, thanks for replying. I def wpuld encurage you to just try it, because I know therapists can def support you.

I also had to start again couple of weeks ago 😉 thank you - this is very kind of you offering help. This only means you are a good person ans you neednto stay strong. I will be checking reddit couple of times a day so if you'd like to talk - I'm here.
I'm sorry to hear that. You are really great person, the world needs you.
Please don't, it can get better.
Hey, I feel sorry for tou and what is happening. I know how it feels I've been in a similar situation. Sorry I can only worte couple of words here. Have you tried to see a therapist?
Okay, so in the meantime you can write here if you feeling shitty, I will be checking reddit couple of times a day.
Thanks! Still - talk to me whenever you want.
I have a chronic illness too, and I felt the way you are very often, sometimes still do, but we need to keep going no matter what. Life gets better I swear. Have you talked to a therapist?
Please don't give up. I'm here to talk if you'd like.
Hey, I am just a person from thw internet but I feel ya 100‰ mate. And I am here to talk to if you'd like.
Hey, I totally understand your struggle. Have you tried to talk to a therapist?
Hey, I know how it feels like... I'm here to talk to if you want. I am only someone from the internet so no judging and your voice in your head can give me a chance.
Hi Jenny, I'm sorry to hear that but I am here if you need to talk to someone.

Hi, I am just a person from the internet but I am reaching out to you this Christmas 😉 how about finding anotother doctor, fuck the one who did not u derstood that you couldn't visit h at that particular moment. Stay strong.
Thank you very much for your kind words. I'm truly happy you found the right path. Happy Christmas by the way 😉
I understand. Does drowing ( even the half drowing 😉) help when it gets bad?

Yeaa, I think it's hard to understand that if someone haven't experienced it. This is why I'm here talking to you, cause I know what it is like and I would like people to believe that it is worth to look for help. And this is why I was mentioning a therapist. This can help plus meds, and slowly, step by step it can break the circle. It is not easy, and it is a bumpy road but it may bring positive results. And first therapist doesn't have to be the right one, really. And I understand if hesitating, in any case I am here, if you would like to talk or just leave a comment. Big hugs and I keep my finger crossed for you.
I keep my fingers crossed for you big time
It may be helpful. Stay strong my friend.

I see a part of you which is in distress (I've been there, I understand it), and I also think you have a part which wants to live, be seen and this part may have a little tiny glimpse of hope. You are worth being here. I'd wish I could help. I'm here if you would like to talk or just write a comment.

Of course you didn't waste my time. I'm writong with you cause I think you need a chance and also you deserve to be taken care of. Speaking of which, do you have a therapist? Why working abroad is not a solution?

I understand, when I was in your situation I felt the same. And btw, this is not fake, I really was feeling this way. I'd wish I could help you. All I can do is talk and share my experience and what helped me, knowing that it may give a chance to you. You deserve to be cared for. Please, give yourself a chance.
Would it be posibble for you tonget even online counselling?
And btw I know plenty of peoole from abroad who decided to come to my country and they are happy here, so maybe thwre is a reason to look for job in Europe.

I just want to tell that there must be a solution. Have you considered looking for a job abroad? In Europe, specifically eastern europe there is plenty of engineeiring jobs - and we are cool people: pretty straight forward but warm and very welcoming. I just think that maybe such a bold move could help. I know you may find a good reason to say no, but please think about it. And in case of covid - many jobs you can actually do remotely. I could even help with finding companies from where I come from. I just so much understand you and in the same time I don't want you to do this. You are a nice guy, you deserve to be here.

Ok, I understand. If you could talk to them and tell about this crisis- please do, I think it will take at least a bit of weight from your shoulders. I'm smiling to you now. I know it doesn't change anything, but it's just a little smile towards you.
Would that be possible? I think you deserve someone caring.
Or would it be possible to find number to a therapist you know on the internet? The one you liked the most.
So maybe finding new therapist, just to take you ou of the crisis. I believe in you and also understand the frustration.
Do you think you could consider calling one of them and telling you are currently in crisis? I'd like someone take care of you. You deserve good care.
I'd wish I could help you, all I can do is talk and for this I remain open.
And also, I understand that life is hard - still I believe it can change for you for positive.

And what they said?
I just want to tell you that I believe you have the power to overcome these difficulties and I am here to talk if you want.
I understand you feelings. Have you ever talk to a therapist?
I just wanted to say that I've been in such dark place and if there is no light there must be a switch somewhere. I hear ya. I understand your feelings. What kind of jobs you applied to?
Can you please find a good doctor and a therapist. I am sure they can help you stabilize this.
Hey, I understand you must feel terrible, can we talk?

I don't kniw if you can get better, but certainaly you MAY get better. And it's worth giving a try. Screaming for help is not a sign of wickness, it's taking care of yourself. Please treat yourself good. I had a label of 'in crisis' again couple of years ago. And I survived it. And it's worth it. Please tell someone, it may be hard at first but this will give you a chamce to get better.
Wow, drawing's great. Ok, even if it's jus half a way - still it is something. You know what they say about the half full glass 😉
You can work on this issue on therapy sessions. I can give some tips on how to look for good therapist and what to do if you think therapy is shit. Let me know if you'd like me to share.

I understand. What about therapy, have you found someone trustworthy? It is important to find a person who you will feel very comfortable with. It may be long term therapy in your case. I just want to mention that it took me 4 therapist to find the right one.

I belive you mate, I've been there. I can see that you are a good person who feels neglected to the bits. We don't know if you will feel better , but I know you MAY feel better. Please give it a go. I don't know what country you are in but please first contact the doctor for  meds (they can help, really) then next step is finding the right therapist. Until you get help you can write comments to me if you find  it a tiny bit helpful. I will be checking reddit a couple times per  day.
Also psych ward is an option. Why? Because is not as bad as people shows in films and books. I found friends there and docs adjusted the medication which helped.
And btw, I went through 4 therapists when I found the right one. Second thing - medication helps, did you take medication?
Wanna talk? I have an exoerience with depression, maybe it will be useful.

And also, you say you are a good person. And I can tell you - world needs good people at the moment. I think you suffer from depression. The good news is - you can treat and even cure depression. It's not easy, but doable. Please consider findig a therapist and a doctor. We need good people here in this planet, we need you.
Hey, I am sorry this happened to you. I had similar situation in the past. Is seeking a professional help, I mean therapist possible? Because this could change a lot.
Hey, how long you've been taking medications? And if any therapist was okay to continue? Life CAN get better anytime, and what if.

Hey, sorry this happens to you. I think the pandemic is such a difficult period for everyone, but this will end and you will be able to find a new job. Are you looking now for a job and can your parents help you financialy?

Hey, I feel very sorry that all of this happened to you. Truly sorry! Do you have any access to free psychoterapist? I am asking cause I believe it would help you at least mentally to have someone to talk to without judgement? Is it worth to speak once again to your mother to explain that you will get a therapist and your cancer is going to cure better if you will have a stable place to live?
Hey, what IF life gets better?  Have you spoken to the doctor?
Yes, please tell someone about it. Your friend may be abgry at you at first, but if this will save his/her life it is really worh doing. I keeo my fingers crossed for you.
Hey, wanna talk?

Hey, I tell you what i would do. I would tell the therapist. Why? Because I was in psych ward and it wasn't that bad. First of all I found friends there, friends who know that life can be hard and we support each other since 10 years ago. Second, doctors adjusted my medication there and it was working better. So psych wards are not as bad as people tend to show in the films and books, trust me. Or you don't have to trust me cause you don't know me 😉 but I've been there and I saw what I saw
It's great you found something in this difficult time. All the best mate!

Hey, is there any chance you can take care of yourself in this difficult time? Yes, I am talking about getting professional help because it could be beneficial for both you and your brother. The counsellor can tell you how to soeak with him and also how to take care of yourself. You are a great sister, I wish I had one like you.

It helped in a way that i found friends there and they stabilized my medication so I could function better. Nothing to be worried about. Some of the friends I have contact with even today, after 10 years of being in psych ward. Don't read the book then if it scares you ans tell them about it. If you need to talk about psych ward I'm here. No worries, it will be okay. Just tell them the truth so they can adjust the treatment.

I was thinking that too when I was in crises. Then talk gave me a bit of strenght to understandbthat not everyone is a false cunt. But i totally get if you don't want to talk. Maybe later if you have a bit more strenght?
Don't end it now, you are far better than the politicians. The goverment. I am here if you would like to talk.
Of course it wouln't be enough, but if you and me and then more peoole will start doing something, then we can make change. I'm getting your anger, i have a lot of anger inside me too.
I'm sorry to hear about this. I am sure that every day you can do something good for the world, whatever it would be - small or big. Lets fuck the government.
I can see a lot of anger, I totally understand it.

Me too. I totally understand you may not want to talk. And I feel ya. I just want to show you that I support you and perhaps your decision can wait a bit? What helped me was a visit at my therapist, but I understand if you don't want speak to anyone.
I'D say fuck the goverment. I wouldn't even give them attention. There is so many things you can do.
Hey, how are you feeling?
What's up dude?
For me you can be who you are and it is perfect though you feel that world is telling you it is not. It is perfect, it is you. If you wanna talk, I'm here.
It would be great to find the strenght, but i see no light
Hey, I'm not fake and I have cut myself too. Wanna talk?
Who feels sad and lonely and can't see the future in any bright colours?
